caption: SAMPLE DATA. I gave an AI agent my inbox for 7 days. The results surprised me. Comment AGENT and I will send you the setup.

transcript.text: I let an AI agent run my inbox for seven days, and day three almost broke it.
Here is the setup: it reads every email, sorts it into three piles, and drafts replies I approve.
Day one was boring in the best way. Forty emails, zero effort.
Day three, it replied to a client with the wrong price. That is the part nobody shows you.
So I added one rule: anything with a number goes to me first.
By day seven I was spending eleven minutes a day on email instead of ninety.
The agent is not the magic. The rules are.
Comment AGENT and I will send you my exact rules.

hook.text: I let an AI agent run my inbox for seven days, and day three almost broke it.
hook.template: I let [TOOL] run my [PAINFUL TASK] for [TIME], and [DAY] almost broke it.
hook.whyItWorks: It promises a story with stakes. 'Seven days' sets a clear arc, and 'almost broke it' opens a loop the viewer needs closed. Concrete, personal, and it hints at failure, which feels honest.

format.pacing: fast: a new visual every 2 to 3 seconds
format.reasoning: A day-by-day diary gives the viewer a reason to stay to the end (what happened on day seven?). The failure on day three is placed in the middle to stop the mid-video drop.

angle.angle: Show the failure, then the fix
angle.commonBelief: AI agents can run your inbox on autopilot.
angle.contrarianTake: The agent only works once you give it hard rules. The rules are the product, not the AI.

visualBreakdown.shot: Close up face, phone in hand
visualBreakdown.why: Big promise in the first frame, readable at scroll speed.

visualBreakdown.shot: Screen recording of an inbox sorting itself
visualBreakdown.why: Movement on screen shows the agent working: proof, not a claim.

visualBreakdown.shot: Red warning flash over a sent email
visualBreakdown.why: Color change and alarm sound mark the twist.

visualBreakdown.shot: Notes app with one rule typed out
visualBreakdown.why: A simple rule the viewer can copy, which drives saves.
Before and after number makes the payoff instant.
One clear call to action, keyword comment boosts reach.

scrollStoppers.why: A time box sets up the story arc in under a second.

scrollStoppers.moment: Red flash and the word 'wrong price'
scrollStoppers.why: Pattern break right where viewers usually swipe.

myVersion.hook: I handed my content calendar to an AI agent for a week, and it nearly posted the wrong video on day four.
myVersion.script:
Hook: I handed my content calendar to an AI agent for a week, and it nearly posted the wrong video on day four.
Setup: what it did each morning, in one sentence.
Twist: day four, the near miss, shown on screen.
Fix: the one approval rule I added.
Payoff: hours saved, with the real number.
CTA: Comment CALENDAR for the rules.
